seo.title: Gallery — Tamara Mack
seo.description: A social-style feed of scripts, reels, spatial studies, and creative technology samples from Tamara Mack.

hero.title: A gallery of experiments, systems, and spatial toys.
hero.lede: Scroll it like a reel or scan it as a grid. Filter by medium and group by series — automation, code, spatial studies, and systems with personality.

categories.label: Scripts
categories.description: Small tools that smooth rough edges: content transforms, deployment helpers, and utility scripts that turn repetitive work into one command.

items.title: Content refactor helpers
items.summary: A cluster of repo scripts for parsing, reshaping, and enriching structured content so cleanup work stays repeatable instead of becoming a one-off editing session.
items.role: Designed for safe iteration on local content and design-token data.

items.title: Deployment and environment helpers
items.summary: Scripts that normalize environment setup, deploy behavior, and release support so local, test, and cloud work feel like one system instead of three unrelated rituals.
items.role: Focused on reducing friction across multi-env delivery.

exhibit.source:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

ENV="${1:-test}"
npm run sam:build
npm run "sam:deploy:${ENV}"

categories.label: Code Snippets
categories.description: Little windows into the way I structure UI and app systems: thoughtful abstractions, content-aware rendering, and pragmatic testing hooks.

items.title: Syntax rendering pipeline
items.summary: Composable syntax-formatting helpers that normalize language aliases and produce consistent, styled markup across multiple content types without burying behavior in giant conditionals.
items.role: Built for clarity, reuse, and predictable output.

items.title: Agentic UI support patterns
items.summary: Small helpers that keep tool-using flows legible: state snapshots, graceful fallbacks, and UI decisions that keep humans in the loop instead of trapped in hidden automation.
items.role: Centered on explainability and resilient interaction design.

categories.label: 3D / XR
categories.description: Work that makes an idea feel tangible: explorable scenes, spatial storytelling, and interface experiments with motion, depth, and presence.

items.title: WebXR concept spaces
items.summary: Browser-based spatial sketches that let collaborators move through an idea, test scale, and react to atmosphere before a concept becomes a production commitment.
items.role: Built to make abstract product direction feel inhabitable.
